entities.summary: Francesco Coco is an Italian retired footballer who played as a defender. Although naturally right-footed, he played as a left wing-back or, more commonly, as a left-back. He had spells with both AC Milan and Inter Milan, also spending a season at Barcelona. In his early career, Coco showed much promise and was regarded as a possible successor to Paolo Maldini; however, he failed to live up to expectations.
